code.description: Discount code generated when a discount coupon is created through the Coupon Service.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, compliant with the ISO 4217 standard.

discountRate.description: Discount expressed as a percentage of the price.

calculationType.description:
Calculation type specifies how the discount should be calculated. Can be set to one of the following:
* `ApplyDiscountBeforeTax`
* `ApplyDiscountAfterTax`

discountCalculationType.description: Determines whether the coupon is applied to the total or subtotal value of the order.

valid.description:
Flag indicating whether the discount is valid. 
Invalid discounts are not taken into account when the cart is calculated.

links.description: Links to Coupon Service endpoints used to validate and redeem the discount.

vendorRestricted.description: Indicates whether the discount is limited to the vendors in `restrictions.vendors`.

discountIndex.description: The index of the discount. It represents the discount position in the cart discounts array.

YRN.title: YRN
YRN.description: A unique identifier of a global resource, which stores information about the resource, such as its type, ID or name of the tenant.

validFrom.description: Start of the discount validity period.

validUntil.description: End of the discount validity period.

allOf.description: Minimum order value copied from the coupon. When `vendorRestricted` is `true`, this value is checked against the total of the matching vendor items.

includedCategories.description: Categories to which the discount applies.

excludedCategories.description: Categories to which the discount does not apply.

segments.description: Customer segments to which the discount applies.

vendors.description: Vendor identifiers to which the discount applies.

rel.description: Action to be done using the endpoint provided in the `href` field.

href.description: Endpoint used to validate or redeem the discount.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, compliant with the ISO 4217 standard.
